messages:
maria: FYI I opened a PR for a small 'Quota scenarios playbook' to live under /docs/usage. Needs: a concise SDK snippet for checking remaining quota, one example (tiered vs burst), and a couple of link fixes. Hoping for quick eyes before tomorrow's docs freeze.
ashley: linking the PR? can take a look in 30m. :)
marIa: oops typo — link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/492 — also docs-ci flagged a broken anchor on the billing page.
sam: I can add the SDK snippet. do we want Py + JS or just one?
maria: both, but keep them 3-4 lines each. show how to call /quota and handle 429 vs throttle headers.
leo: recommend small scenario table instead of long prose — e.g., columns: situation, expected response, suggested client behavior. helps support and customers.
ben: agree with leo. also add a short note about burst credits expiring at month end. customers keep asking.
ashley: from an editorial POV: keep examples copyable and add a note about unit names (tokens vs compute units). Users get confused.
sam: drafting snippets now. provisional JS snippet:
```js
// get remaining quota (JS SDK)
const res = await client.get('/quota');
if (res.status === 200) console.log(res.data.remaining);
if (res.status === 429) console.warn('rate limited', res.headers['x-retry-after']);
```

and Py: 
```py
# get remaining quota (Python)
res = client.get('/quota')
if res.status_code == 200:
    print(res.json()['remaining'])
elif res.status_code == 429:
    print('rate limited', res.headers.get('Retry-After'))
```

leo: perfect, short and actionable. can we also include a snippet showing how to switch to a cheaper model variant on 429 fallback? one-liner pseudocode ok.
sam: sure, adding fallback example: `if 429: retry_with(model='small-quantized')`
maria: nice. docs-ci — can you re-run link check after I push these edits? last run failed anchor 'billing#quota-headers'.
docs-ci: Link checker report: 1 failed anchor (billing#quota-headers). Re-run triggered by push to branch docs/pr-492.
ashley: quick editorial nit — change heading "Quota behavior" -> "Quota & rate-limit behavior" so it's clearer in TOC.
ben: also add a short example in the dashboard section showing how to read the "remaining allowance" panel; one screenshot placeholder is fine for this PR.
maria: I'll upload screenshot placeholder and add a TODO to replace with final one. pushing updated branch in 10.
sam: once pushed I can squash and add a brief changelog entry for release notes. do we need engineering signoff?
leo: no infra changes, just docs. review from product and eng-ml appreciated but not required.
maria: tagging @ashley and @sam for review. thanks all. :thumbsup:
docs-ci: CI status: linkcheck running... will post results in-thread.
